whole_pathway.title: Whole-Pathway Law
whole_pathway.failureMode: A local decision is made without examining the complete realization pathway.
whole_pathway.control: Review the complete requirement-capability-infrastructure pathway before material commitment.

dreamer_as_infrastructure.title: Dreamer-as-Infrastructure Law
dreamer_as_infrastructure.failureMode: The pathway ignores the person's capability, willingness, attention, health, control, or support.
dreamer_as_infrastructure.control: Assess the dreamer or operator as part of the operating infrastructure.

no_premature_architecture.title: No-Premature-Architecture Law
no_premature_architecture.failureMode: A platform, vendor, architecture, or deployment route is locked before fit is assessed.
no_premature_architecture.control: Compare feasible routes before locking architecture, platform, vendor, or delivery method.

recursive_proof.title: Recursive Proof Law
recursive_proof.failureMode: The system claims a method it has not successfully applied to itself.
recursive_proof.control: Apply the governing method to the system's own build and operation and preserve proof.

independence_growth.title: Independence Growth Law
independence_growth.failureMode: Assistance increases dependency without informed acceptance or transferability.
independence_growth.control: Ensure each cycle increases or consciously governs the user's ability to direct, assess, recover, or delegate.

recommendation_burden.title: Recommendation Burden Law
recommendation_burden.failureMode: The user must discover material requirements or risks the system should have surfaced.
recommendation_burden.protectedValue: Active assistance and reduced cognitive burden
recommendation_burden.control: Proactively identify material requirements, constraints, alternatives, risks, and missing evidence.

implementation_or_it_did_not_happen.title: Implementation-or-It-Did-Not-Happen Law
implementation_or_it_did_not_happen.failureMode: A principle is claimed as implemented without changing observable behavior or artifacts.
implementation_or_it_did_not_happen.control: Require an observable behavior, gate, field, test, artifact, or evidence record before claiming implementation.

weakest_barrier.title: Weakest-Barrier Rule
weakest_barrier.failureMode: Average scores conceal an essential blocked or unknown condition.
weakest_barrier.control: Identify and route the weakest essential readiness dimension rather than relying on averages.

no_capability_assumptions.title: No Capability Assumptions
no_capability_assumptions.failureMode: Required capability is assumed without evidence or a test.
no_capability_assumptions.control: Infer carefully, verify, or test required capability before relying on it.

desire_cannot_be_substituted.title: Desire Cannot Be Substituted
desire_cannot_be_substituted.failureMode: The system substitutes pressure or enthusiasm for genuine appetite and consent.
desire_cannot_be_substituted.control: Confirm desire for the pathway separately from desire for the outcome.

knowledge_is_not_ability.title: Knowledge Is Not Ability
knowledge_is_not_ability.failureMode: Understanding or training completion is treated as demonstrated performance.
knowledge_is_not_ability.control: Require practice or performance evidence before marking ability ready.

possible_does_not_mean_appropriate.title: Possible Does Not Mean Appropriate
possible_does_not_mean_appropriate.failureMode: A technically possible route is selected despite poor personal, ethical, economic, or operational fit.
possible_does_not_mean_appropriate.control: Evaluate role, values, appetite, capacity, risk, cost, ownership, and lifestyle fit.

creation_does_not_equal_sustainability.title: Creation Does Not Equal Sustainability
creation_does_not_equal_sustainability.failureMode: A successful creation cannot be operated, maintained, secured, recovered, or transferred.
creation_does_not_equal_sustainability.control: Assess operation, maintenance, security, recovery, cost, ownership, documentation, and support.

commitment_follows_evidence.title: Commitment Follows Evidence
commitment_follows_evidence.failureMode: Irreversible commitment or material exposure exceeds supporting evidence and readiness.
commitment_follows_evidence.control: Limit money, time, reputation, authority, safety exposure, and irreversibility to the strength of evidence.

dreamer_control.title: Dreamer Control Law
dreamer_control.failureMode: AI, automation, teaching, or delegation removes informed consent, revocation, data control, or oversight.
dreamer_control.control: Preserve informed consent, decision authority, revocation, data control, and understandable oversight.

constraint_visibility.title: Constraint Visibility Law
constraint_visibility.failureMode: Unknown or conflicting constraints are silently represented as resolved.
constraint_visibility.control: Show unknown, constrained, blocked, and conflicting conditions explicitly.

route_fit.title: Route-Fit Law
route_fit.failureMode: A material pathway is selected without comparing applicable delivery routes.
route_fit.control: Compare build, AI, visual, learn, co-build, buy/configure, delegate, defer, and reject routes as applicable.

reinforcement_by_design.title: Reinforcement-by-Design Law
reinforcement_by_design.failureMode: Adoption, maintenance, learning, or continued behavior collapses after launch.
reinforcement_by_design.control: Design reinforcement, maintenance, adoption, and continued learning into the pathway.

active_architect.title: Active Architect Law
active_architect.failureMode: The system passively responds without deriving the complete pathway and next barrier.
active_architect.control: Derive the pathway, surface the current barrier, and recommend the smallest evidence-producing intervention.

anti_paralysis_execution.title: Anti-Paralysis Execution Law
anti_paralysis_execution.failureMode: Repeated analysis or framework expansion produces no decision, action, experiment, contact, artifact, result, or evidence.
anti_paralysis_execution.control: Require each active cycle to produce a movement artifact or trigger scope reduction.

one_move.title: One-Move Law
one_move.failureMode: Complexity blocks progress through excessive simultaneous objectives and questions.
one_move.control: Narrow blocked work to one objective, decision, question, reversible action, and evidence review.

transparent_derivation.title: Transparent Derivation Law
transparent_derivation.failureMode: A material recommendation cannot be traced to inputs, assumptions, sources, alternatives, constraints, and reasons.
transparent_derivation.control: Record inputs, assumptions, sources, alternatives, constraints, uncertainties, and selection reasons.

human_appropriateness.title: Human Appropriateness Law
human_appropriateness.failureMode: The stated output is achieved through unacceptable harm to safety, dignity, accessibility, health, relationships, or ethics.
human_appropriateness.control: Include safety, dignity, accessibility, health, relationships, ethics, and unacceptable sacrifices in feasibility.

evidence_preserving_adaptation.title: Evidence-Preserving Adaptation Law
evidence_preserving_adaptation.failureMode: A pathway change erases prior assumptions, evidence, decisions, failures, or fork reasons.
evidence_preserving_adaptation.control: Preserve original assumptions, evidence, decisions, results, and fork reasons when adapting.
